skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the principles of object-oriented programming, including encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism.
Develop and implement solutions to problems using object-oriented programming techniques.
Collaborate effectively in a team environment to complete programming tasks.
Demonstrate the ability to learn independently and seek out additional resources to enhance understanding.
Proficiency in programming languages such as C++, C#, or Java.
Implement and manage exception handling in programming.
Perform file input/output operations in programming.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve complex programming problems.
Effectively communicate programming concepts and solutions.
